repair_scope.failure_observed: The V1 execution stopped at the season-availability gate because official Signy data contain no 2010 breeding-pair season.
repair_scope.only_change: Primary end season changes from 2010 to 2009, yielding the maximal contiguous post-1997 pre-A39 interval available in the official source.

replication_role: Independent system replication of Palmer progressive within-island breeding concentration.

source.dataset: Population size and breeding success of Adelie penguins on Signy Island from 1978 to 2020

primary_epoch.selection_rule: Maximal contiguous official-data interval beginning after the incomplete 1997 season and ending before the first structurally missing season (2010) and before A39 roster expansion (2011).
primary_epoch.gate: Every season 1998-2009 must contain a finite nonnegative breeding-pair count for exactly the expected literal roster; otherwise stop without further repair.

metric.primary_statistic: OLS slope of N_eff against season_start_year

null.positive_total_conditioning: Redraw zero-total simulations for observed-positive seasons.

decision.replication_supported: Observed slope < 0 and p <= 0.05 under all three frozen error models.

terminal_rules: No further start/end-year repair is permitted.
Do not drop low-count or zero-count colonies.
Do not substitute another concentration index or threshold.
Do not add error CV values without independent calibration.
Supported replication concerns breeding-space concentration only, not movement or causal habitat mechanism.
